# Anmol Graphics

> Leading manufacturer and wholesale supplier of School ID Cards, Corporate ID Cards, RFID Smart Cards, Multi-color Custom Lanyards, Badges, and Identification Accessories based in India.

Anmol Graphics specializes in high-quality identification solutions for schools, colleges, universities, corporate offices, government institutions, events, and exhibitions. We manufacture durable PVC cards, RFID contactless smart cards, digital satin/sublimation printed lanyards, custom badges, card holders, and attachment clips with full custom branding and pan-India delivery.

## Core Products & Services

- [ID Cards & Smart Cards](https://anmolgraphics.in/products): Premium thermal-printed and offset-printed PVC cards including School ID Cards, Corporate ID Cards, Student Identity Cards, and Membership Cards.
- [RFID & Proximity Cards](https://anmolgraphics.in/products): 125 kHz Proximity Cards and 13.56 MHz Mifare / Contactless Smart Cards for attendance, access control, library, and canteen management systems.
- [Custom Printed Lanyards](https://anmolgraphics.in/products): Multi-color digital sublimation printed and screen-printed polyester/satin lanyards (12mm, 16mm, 20mm) customized with company or school logos and safety breakaway releases.
- [Badges & Rosettes](https://anmolgraphics.in/products): Magnetic name badges, pin badges, button badges, metallic badges, and event award rosettes.
- [Card Holders & Accessories](https://anmolgraphics.in/products): Hard plastic card holders, soft transparent vinyl pouches, retractable badge reels (YoYo), alligator clips, metal swivel hooks, and snap clips.

## Business Details & Ordering

- Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): Flexible for both small orders and large bulk institutional supplies.
- Customization: Full custom design support, variable data printing (photos, barcodes, QR codes, names, serial numbers).
- Turnaround: Fast production with reliable delivery across India.
